articles.title: Mumbai mayor Ritu Tawde: A short tenure, a growing list of tiffs
articles.description: From controversies over a luxury watch and VIP lights to civic tenders and friction with party colleagues, Mumbai Mayor Tawde’s increasingly assertive style has put her at odds with the Opposition, BMC officials and even leaders within the ruling alliance. Nayonika Bose writes

articles.title: RTI reveals Power dept floated only one transformer tender in 7 yrs
articles.description: SHILLONG, Aug 30: RTI findings have revealed that the state Power department floated only one tender for distribution transformers in nearly seven years, with no tenders issued for transformer repair work during the same period. articles.title: Europe Electric Bus Market to Reach USD 33.96 Billion by 2035, Growing at 21.5% CAGR
articles.description: Italy is advancing at the continent's highest growth rate, with Rome and Milan collectively tendering over 1,200 electric buses between 2024 and 2027.
